newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dalian Refrigeration in venture with Japan firm.
newsitem.headline: Dalian Refrigeration in venture with Japan firm.

text.p: Dalian Refrigeration Equipment Co Ltd shareholders have approved a three-for-10 rights offer to finance an air-conditioner parts venture with a Japanese firm, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin that Dalian Refrigeration plans to price the offer at between four and five yuan per share subject to final approval by the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
The official said Dalian Refrigeration aimed to channel most of the money raised to a venture in Dalian, in northeastern Liaoning province, with a Japanese firm.

The Shenzhen-listed firm would have a 70 percent in the 54 million yuan venture, contributing production facilities and part of the cash, with the remaining 30 percent held by the Japanese partner, he added.
The official said the venture would specialise in making parts for air-conditioners, with the annual investment return ratio estimated at 20 percent.
He declined to provide a timetable for the project.

Dalian Refrigeration said in an interim report for 1996 that based on Chinese accounting standards it had audited after-tax profits of 62.05 million yuan in the first half of 1996. This compares with 23.52 million yuan in the same 1995 period.
The company, which mainly produces refrigerator parts, said the rise in profits was mainly due to solid returns from its joint ventures, including its 40 percent-owned Dalian Sanyo Compressor Co Ltd.
The company said last month it would file an application with the regulatory commission to offer US$20 million worth of class B shares for listing in Shenzhen.
